intro: Kansas City's non-climate 10x10 street rate is $107/month, down 0.9% from a year earlier (StorageCafe, September 2026). Storage Stats puts the Kansas City metro non-climate 10x10 asking rent at $102, down 6.3% from a year earlier (October 28, 2026). The climate-controlled 10x10 figure on the same StorageCafe page is about $126. The advertised rate on this page averages the published figures above. Once the move-in special ends and the first existing-customer increase lands, the six-month average sits above that street rate.
data_asof: Sep 2026 (StorageCafe street rates); no StorageUnitCosts city page; Oct 2026 (Storage Stats metro)

units.notes: Locker / closet size. Fixed fees dominate the true cost at this size. StorageCafe street rate $49 (Sep 2026). Climate-controlled figure on the same page ~$55.
Walk-in closet; studio overflow. StorageCafe street rate $69 (Sep 2026). Climate-controlled figure on the same page ~$85. No reliable lowest-promo figure published for this size (gap).

Most rented size. City street rate $107, down 0.9% from a year earlier (StorageCafe industry statistics, Sep 2026). Storage Stats Kansas City metro non-climate asking rent $102, down 6.3% from a year earlier (updated Oct 28, 2026). That figure covers the metro, not Kansas City alone. StorageUnitCosts does not publish this city. Climate-controlled figure on the same page ~$126.
Two-bedroom contents. StorageCafe street rate $135 (Sep 2026). Climate-controlled figure on the same page ~$162.
Three-bedroom home or a car. StorageCafe street rate $168 (Sep 2026). Climate-controlled figure on the same page ~$212.

local_tips: StorageCafe lists Paseo West (~$77), Santa Fe Hills - Boone Hills (~$95), Fairwood - Robandee (~$95) among the cheaper areas for a standard unit. Kci & 2nd Creek (~$216) is among the highest.
Kansas City has about 47 facilities and 3.8 sq ft of storage per person (StorageCafe).
About 85,800 sq ft of new storage is projected for 2026, a increase of 7% from the year before (StorageCafe). Ask what month five costs before taking a move-in discount.
Extra Space's published admin fee is $50 on StorageUnitCosts' fee notes, higher than our $29 default; adjust the calculator if your facility charges more.
